deliverables: WP1 – Enabling Onchain Payments & Card Infrastructure
Smart contract engineering, account abstraction, batched transactions, settlement logic, and wallet/API ecosystem layer
Visa card issuance linked directly to onchain balances
Milestone-based disbursement controls through Intersect treasury management smart contracts
request.recipient: 2026 Treasury Reserve Smart Contract stake address stake1784sdxt6jjennmstphgdu7l7c2scf5d02a6cve2dgn5s2kq5u3j9v, with project funds later transferred to a Project-Specific Smart Contract for the Wirex project.
request.what: Bringing Real-World Payments to Cardano with Wirex through open-source payments infrastructure, onchain settlement, smart contracts, wallet/API ecosystem components, banking rails, stablecoin systems, and Visa card integration.

claims.claim: The proposal requests 3,961,538 ada, consisting of 3,846,153 ada for WP1 and a 115,385 ada Intersect Budget Administration fee.
The on-chain metadata lists a treasury withdrawal reward of 3,961,538,000,000 lovelace to the 2026 Treasury Reserve Smart Contract stake address.
Wirex will deliver full-stack open-source payments infrastructure connecting Cardano onchain settlement to smart contracts, banking rails, stablecoin systems, and wallet interfaces.
A core outcome is Visa card issuance linked directly to onchain balances so users can spend digital assets globally at millions of merchants.
Wirex has 7 million users, over 1.5 million cards issued, more than 20 billion dollars in transaction volume, and experience as a Visa Principal Member.
The proposal achieved the required 67% support threshold during the 2026 Intersect Budget Process Hydra Voting phase.
The requested withdrawal does not, at submission, breach the applicable 350M ada Net Change Limit for Epoch 613 to Epoch 713.
Wirex has not received ada from the Cardano Treasury within the last 24 months.

Treasury funds will be managed through Intersect’s Sundae Labs smart contract framework with named reserve and project-specific addresses, multisig-like authorization thresholds, external oversight entities, and milestone-based disbursement controls.
A public dashboard and on-chain records are provided for community audit and tracking of the withdrawn ada.

summary: The document describes a 3,961,538 ada treasury withdrawal administered by Intersect for Wirex to build Cardano real-world payments infrastructure, with budget breakdown, on-chain reward metadata, smart-contract custody details, oversight process, and external references for voting, audits, and treasury-contract tooling.
